Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Toshinori Yagi (All Might) Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6617]Toshinori Yagi - All Might - NPC - Hero Academia[/url] mod Npc Toshinori Yagi (All Might) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/11961608]RememberEmber[/url] asked, I tried to draw in style that fits with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url].
Including seasonal outfit portraits, default no mask variation.
TW: Blood.

Make sure you have [b]PyTK[/b] mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your Toshinori mod (somewhere in [b]Stardew Valley\Mods folder[/b])
Drag the folders from my zip ([b][CP] Toshinori NPC[/b]) to the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\Toshinori NPC[/b] folder to overwrite the folders in it for it to work.  



23/08/2021: Uploaded content Patcher version.
I would still recommend the replacement file version since the assets won't get loaded 2 times. But if the replacement file doesn't work for you, try this version.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6617]Toshinori Yagi - All Might - NPC - Hero Academia[/url] mod.)

The NPCs belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6617]Toshinori Yagi - All Might - NPC - Hero Academia[/url] : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38334760]AeolianMode[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
